selection_reason: Adapts conformal gating to LLM routing between Mixtral-8x7B and GPT-4 with a guaranteed violation rate among queries sent to the cheaper model; a routing method whose explicit objective is reducing inference cost safely.
title: Conformal LLM Routing with Distribution-Free Safety Guarantees
